name: referee_battery_veteran_home_cover
hypothesis: Home team's referee has >= 5 distinct prior dataset-visible seasons as head referee -- home cover rate vs. everyone else. Mechanism: documented officiating-bias literature attributes home-field penalty bias partly to crowd-noise pressure on officials' split-second judgment; more experienced referees are hypothesized to be less susceptible to that pressure, producing a smaller home-cover edge in veteran-officiated games than the rest of the slate. Population restricted to 2016-2025 to exclude the 2015 left-censoring artifact (every referee shows 0 prior seasons in 2015 purely from data coverage, not genuine debuts -- see docs/referee_battery.md). Predeclared docs/referee_battery.md; recorded regardless of sign.

reliability_check.reason: prior_seasons_experience is a monotonically increasing career-stage counter, not a trait whose value could repeat or correlate year-over-year in the split-half sense -- there is nothing to split-half (analogous to backup_qb_start's per-game career-stage condition, also not_applicable).
